The '''Aesea Killik Hives''' was a series of [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] nests and a cave system in the [[Glarus Valley]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was inhabited by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of the [[Aesea]] hive.
